verses.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Hear, O God, my voice of complaint; preserve my life from dread of the enemy.

xrefs.text: I sought the LORD, and He answered me; He delivered me from all my fears.
A Psalm of David. O LORD, hear my prayer. In Your faithfulness, give ear to my plea; in Your righteousness, answer me.
A Psalm of David. I call upon You, O LORD; come quickly to me. Hear my voice when I call to You.
A song of ascents. Out of the depths I cry to You, O LORD!
For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Rescue me, O LORD, from evil men. Protect me from men of violence,

verses.text: Hide me from the scheming of the wicked, from the mob of workers of iniquity,

xrefs.text: You hide them in the secret place of Your presence from the schemes of men. You conceal them in Your shelter from accusing tongues.
Deliver me from my enemies, O LORD; I flee to You for refuge.
For wicked and deceitful mouths open against me; they speak against me with lying tongues.
Deliver me from workers of iniquity, and save me from men of bloodshed.

For I was like a gentle lamb led to slaughter; I did not know that they had plotted against me: “Let us destroy the tree with its fruit; let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be remembered no more.”

verses.text: who sharpen their tongues like swords and aim their bitter words like arrows,

xrefs.text: The tongue also is a fire, a world of wickedness among the parts of the body. It pollutes the whole person, sets the course of his life on fire, and is itself set on fire by hell.
“They bend their tongues like bows; lies prevail over truth in the land. For they proceed from evil to evil, and they do not take Me into account,” declares the LORD.
My soul is among the lions; I lie down with ravenous beasts— with men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.
May they vanish like water that runs off; when they draw the bow, may their arrows be blunted.
No weapon formed against you shall prosper, and you will refute every tongue that accuses you. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their vindication is from Me,” declares the LORD.

verses.text: ambushing the innocent in seclusion, shooting suddenly, without fear.

xrefs.text: God will hear and humiliate them— the One enthroned for the ages— Selah because they do not change and they have no fear of God.
“He committed no sin, and no deceit was found in His mouth.”
He lies in wait near the villages; in ambush he slays the innocent; his eyes watch in stealth for the helpless.
For behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrow on the string to shoot from the shadows at the upright in heart.

And David said to all the servants with him in Jerusalem, “Arise and let us flee, or we will not escape from Absalom! We must leave quickly, or he will soon overtake us, heap disaster on us, and put the city to the sword.”

verses.text: They hold fast to their evil purpose; they speak of hiding their snares. “Who will see them?” they say.

xrefs.text: The proud hide a snare for me; the cords of their net are spread along the path, and lures are set out for me. Selah
He says to himself, “God has forgotten; He hides His face and never sees.”
Yet you say: ‘What does God know? Does He judge through thick darkness?

“Son of man,” He said to me, “do you see what the elders of the house of Israel are doing in the darkness, each at the shrine of his own idol? For they are saying, ‘The LORD does not see us; the LORD has forsaken the land.’”
They say, “The LORD does not see; the God of Jacob pays no heed.”

verses.text: They devise injustice and say, “We have perfected a secret plan.” For the inner man and the heart are mysterious.

xrefs.text: Now the chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were seeking false testimony against Jesus in order to put Him to death.
The heart is deceitful above all things and beyond cure. Who can understand it?
For not a word they speak can be trusted; destruction lies within them. Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.
Woe to those who dig deep to hide their plans from the LORD. In darkness they do their works and say, “Who sees us, and who will know?”

Therefore judge nothing before the appointed time; wait until the Lord comes. He will bring to light what is hidden in darkness and will expose the motives of men’s hearts. At that time each will receive his praise from God.

verses.text: But God will shoot them with arrows; suddenly they will be wounded.

xrefs.text: If one does not repent, God will sharpen His sword; He has bent and strung His bow.
Therefore calamity will come upon him suddenly; in an instant he will be shattered beyond recovery.
For you are fully aware that the Day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.
He shot His arrows and scattered the foes; He hurled lightning and routed them.
this iniquity of yours is like a breach about to fail, a bulge in a high wall, whose collapse will come suddenly— in an instant!

verses.text: They will be made to stumble, their own tongues turned against them. All who see will shake their heads.

xrefs.text: A fool’s mouth is his ruin, and his lips are a snare to his soul.
An evil man is trapped by his rebellious speech, but a righteous man escapes from trouble.
May the heads of those who surround me be covered in the trouble their lips have caused.
His master replied, ‘You wicked servant, I will judge you by your own words. So you knew that I am a harsh man, withdrawing what I did not deposit and reaping what I did not sow?
Your own mouth, not mine, condemns you; your own lips testify against you.

verses.text: Then all mankind will fear and proclaim the work of God; so they will ponder what He has done.

xrefs.text: “The LORD has brought forth our vindication; come, let us tell in Zion what the LORD our God has accomplished.”
Whoever is wise, let him understand these things; whoever is discerning, let him know them. For the ways of the LORD are right, and the righteous walk in them but the rebellious stumble in them.
He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear and put their trust in the LORD.
At their feasts are the lyre and harp, tambourines and flutes and wine. They disregard the actions of the LORD and fail to see the work of His hands.
The upright see and rejoice, and all iniquity shuts its mouth.

verses.text: Let the righteous rejoice in the LORD and take refuge in Him; let all the upright in heart exult.

xrefs.text: Be glad in the LORD and rejoice, O righteous ones; shout for joy, all you upright in heart.
He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear and put their trust in the LORD.
It is because of Him that you are in Christ Jesus, who has become for us wisdom from God: our righteousness, holiness, and redemption.
His descendants will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
Guard my soul and deliver me; let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in You.
